company.name: Sardine
company.shortDescription: Sardine is a fraud prevention and compliance software company for the digital economy.
company.description: Sardine specializes in providing risk management solutions primarily for the financial services sector. They focus on using artificial intelligence and machine learning to help enterprises manage risks associated with fraud, credit, and compliance. The company aims to serve businesses in the digital economy by offering tools and services that enhance operational efficiency and ensure regulatory compliance.

aiResearchSummary.text: Sardine is developing systems for fraud prevention and compliance by analyzing behavioral biometrics and transaction data. Age prediction of end users based on input device data and same person detection of end users based on input device data infer user attributes and continuity from sensor signals. Augmented responses to risk inquiries, transaction evaluation based on a machine learning projection of future account, and risk insights utility for traditional finance and decentralized finance generate risk insights and transaction evaluations. Together these efforts target identity analytics and risk scoring.
